notes.title: Update V1.0.2
notes.content:
Feature Updates:
[list]
[*] Players can now tap on items from other dreams via the phone to move them into the current dream.
[*] Added parabolic trajectory for thrown objects.
[*] Added a display of the last save time on the exit screen.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the magnet model in the coffin would not disappear after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a clipping issue with cemetery stones after loading a save.
[*] Fixed abnormal behavior of the door on the small boat.
[*] Fixed abnormal behavior when closing menu windows using a key.
[*] Fixed an issue where fullscreen prompts would not disappear.
[/list]

Optimization:
[list]
[*] Improved screen display effects in the scene.
[*] Removed the altar's magnetic effect on held objects and optimized the attraction logic.
[*] Optimized the hint interface.
[/list]

notes.title: Dream of Things is OUT NOW !
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone! [/p][p]We're happy to announce that Dream of Things launchs Steam today![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2930950/Dream_of_Things/"][/dynamiclink]The story of Dream of Things takes place in a large mansion. You wake up in a strange room, realizing that you have already died — and lost all of your memories.[/p][p]Even more bizarre, you discover that you can communicate with various objects in the mansion through a mobile phone. They all seem to know you well. From shower curtain to mirror, chandelier to old clock, each seemingly ordinary household item contains a mysterious space full of mechanisms and puzzles. Talk to them, gather clues, help them with their troubles, and piece together the truth of your past — and the hidden secrets of this world.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is 10% off during the first two weeks after launch—don’t miss this chance![/p][p][/p][p]Welcome to our Discord channel: [url="https://discord.gg/vnptNVkxGK"]https://discord.gg/vnptNVkxGK[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
